notes: sampler_core.gds carries no top-level pin shapes or labels; each analog boundary connection is a declared port on existing conductor (analog_port_*), audited against an extraction of the analog GDS.
Whole-block external pins: the 16 boundary pads (pad shapes, label on the routed net) and the 107 digital pins (label on the digital macro's own pin shape).
raw_bit and raw_valid are macro-to-macro nets with no boundary pin.
Bus bit order: bus_addr[3:0], bus_wdata/bus_rdata/out_data[31:0]; names are the GDS pin labels (bus index in brackets, bit 0 = LSB).
